why: VAMPIRES ARE THE FUEL, NOT THE ENGINE (the pilot, 2026-11-11): blood drain, life gain, action at a distance, ferocious; pings that snowball, never a two-card infinite; bracket 3. As of 2026-11-13 the branch is nineteen out, nineteen in against the sleeved v3.0.0, in five jobs. DRAIN ON EVERY DEATH: Zulaport Cutthroat, Elas il-Kor, Falkenrath Noble, Bastion of Remembrance and The Meathook Massacre drain each opponent, Teysa Karlov doubles them, Skullclamp draws off them. THE LOOP: Pitiless Plunderer + Ashnod's Altar with Oathsworn Vampire or Reassembling Skeleton and a drainer (stack 013); the burst turn with Teysa (stack 014); both checker-passed. REMOVAL WITH FANGS (log 008 and the pilot, 2026-11-13): Swords to Plowshares, Vanishing Verse, Crackling Doom (an edict through hexproof), Toxic Deluge (Olivia's Wrath killed the branch's own non-Vampire engines). PROTECTION THAT NEEDS NO COMMANDER: Boros Charm, Selfless Spirit, Giver of Runes replace Deflecting Swat and Flawless Maneuver, which sat in hand until Edgar (six mana) was out; the pilot: protection is always needed against the A team. MANA: thirty-five lands (Sacred Foundry, a Plains) for the Talismans and Rakdos Signet. Wispdrinker Vampire stays (cut in iteration two, restored: an entering-token drain the pilot credited in log 008). Rejected 2026-11-13: Anowon (taxes the branch's own non-Vampires), Impact Tremors / Corpse Knight / Ayara (the pilot did not like the cuts), Dauntless Bodyguard (Selfless Spirit does it for the board). Forge A/B (iteration one, 200/arm, olivers-table-nov): no resolvable difference on life removed, removal cast doubled; the AI rarely assembles the loop.
